description.text: Program Description The students mainly study the basic theory of basic medicine, clinical medicine, anesthesiology knowledge and clinical medicine, anesthesiology, basic techniques, anesthesia recovery of basic training, first aid and life, and has a common surgical anesthesia processing, the preoperative complications prevention and critical condition monitor, diagnose and treatment of the basic skills. Duration 5 years

duration.text: The Anesthesiology at Dalian Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be between 18 and 25 2.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate, or must have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level or equivalent. 3.Not less than 60% score in science subjects (Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, and Biology). 4.Good at English.
